editions.text:
The day logged 222 feeder visits and 20 species, slightly above the seven-day averages. Daily visit counts for the week ranged from 99 to 302. Tufted Titmice and Carolina Chickadees held positions on the seed tubes throughout, while the Carolina Wren provided the bulk of the 334 vocal detections.

Tufted Titmice registered 113 confident visits, significantly more than any other species. Northern Cardinals and Carolina Chickadees rounded out the top visual counters, with Cardinals also contributing to the audio record. The last confident visual record arrived from a Northern Cardinal shortly after sunset.
